caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical wooden object with a rounded handle and a flat, circular face. The predominant color is a natural, muted tan-brown, resembling unfinished or lightly varnished wood. The flat end of the object features a detailed carved design: a large, central heart shape filled with a crosshatched pattern, surrounded by a border with triangular and curved decorative elements, as well as a finely notched rim. The surface of the object is smooth, with gentle shading indicating dimensionality and the contours of the handle and carved face. The object is presented against a plain, off-white background with no additional elements or context.
title: Butter Mold
